description: Selected A/B parameters from the 2026-10-19 / 2026-10-31 diagnostic comparisons; full common coverage
notes: Gaussian wavelength is not output grid spacing.
Selected LB output is 120 x 120 m for ionosphere estimation; A remains 40 x 40 m. Both use coherence-adaptive Goldstein with a 32 x 32 pixel patch.
NCORRLOOKS A=32 / B=8 preserves the comparison settings; these are provisional, not measured independent looks.
Overlapping SNAPHU tiles are assembled into one phase grid; component labels remain tile-local.
Different DEM/processing versions in this pair remain an unresolved scientific limitation.
